title: Count Substring Query
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 3 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \leq |S| \leq 5 \times 10^5; 1 \leq Q \leq 5 \times 10^5; 1 \leq |T_i| \leq |S|; \displaystyle \sum_{i=1}^Q |T_i| \leq 5 \times 10^5; S and T_i are strings consisting of lowercase English letters.; Q is an integer.
